req.title: Register form GET
req.statement: The system shall serve a registration form at GET /auth/register.

doc.reasoning: The test suite is designed to validate the requirement that the system serves a registration form at GET /auth/register. It includes positive, negative, and boundary cases to ensure comprehensive coverage and mutation resilience.

tests.name: test_register_form_get_positive
preconditions: The application is running in test mode.
expected: The response contains the registration form HTML.
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()
r = client.get('/auth/register')
assert r.status_code == 200
assert b'<form' in r.data
assert b'name="username"' in r.data
assert b'name="password"' in r.data

tests.name: test_register_form_get_negative
preconditions: The application is running in test mode.
actions: Send a POST request to /auth/register without data.
expected: Receive an HTTP 400 response or an error message indicating a bad request.
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()
r = client.post('/auth/register')
assert r.status_code == 400 or b'Bad Request' in r.data

tests.name: test_register_form_get_boundary
preconditions: The application is running in test mode.
actions: Send a GET request to /auth/register with a very long query string.
expected: The response contains the registration form HTML.
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()
long_query = '?' + 'a' * 1000
r = client.get('/auth/register' + long_query)
assert r.status_code == 200
assert b'<form' in r.data
assert b'name="username"' in r.data
assert b'name="password"' in r.data
